test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The measures of the outer dimensions of a closed metal box are given as 15 cm × 18 cm × 8 cm. The thickness of the metal is 1.5 cm. What will be the volume of the metal required to make the box?
solution:
**Given: **

External,

Length = 15 cm

Breadth = 18 cm

Width = 8 cm

Internal,

Length = 15 - 3 = 12 cm

Breadth = 18 - 3 = 15 cm

Width = 8 - 3 = 5 cm

**Formula used:**

Volume of the cuboid = length × breadth × height

**Calculation: **

External volume of metallic box = 15 × 18 × 8

⇒ 2160 cm³

Internal volume of metallic box = 12 × 15 × 5

⇒ 900

Volume of metal = external volume - internal volume

⇒ 2160 - 900 = 1260 cm³

**∴ The required volume is 1260 cm³**.
